typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Aging as string,
		{Next Action Date} as string,
		{Case ID} as string,
		Nostro as string,
		CCY as string,
		{CCY Amount} as string,
		{USD Equiv Amt} as string,
		{Value date} as string,
		Side as string,
		{D C} as string,
		{Case type} as string,
		{Case Sub Type} as string,
		{Case Status} as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		{User Update Date Time} as string,
		{Tran Ref} as string,
		{Incoming TRN} as string,
		{CMR ID} as string,
		{Customer Legal Name} as string,
		{Covering Employee Name} as string,
		Dept as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		RTMBInd as string,
		CaseCreationDate as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		DIRECTION as string,
		FIELD20_2 as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Item_ID as string,
		{Source Reference} as string,
		MT as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Description as string,
		midasDealNumber as string,
		Deal_Number as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		Source as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		rate as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Bank_Ref as string,
		Beneficiary as string,
		Line_86_Stmt_Text as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		Notes as string,
		PgDesignation as integer,
		ReportDate as date,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		Aging_Bucket_order as integer,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd as string,
		OSI as string,
		UNASSIGNED_FLAG as integer,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG as integer,
		UN_ACTIONED as integer,
		UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SWIFTSTATUS} = SWIFTSTATUS,
		{Copy of ThirdPartyCCYInd} = ThirdPartyCCYInd,
		{Copy of ReportDate} = toString(ReportDate),
		{Copy of midasDealNumber} = midasDealNumber,
		{Copy of UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG} = toString(UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG),
		{Copy of Nostro} = Nostro,
		{Copy of Side} = Side,
		{Copy of Aging_Bucket_order} = toString(Aging_Bucket_order),
		{Copy of MT} = MT,
		{Copy of Line_86_Stmt_Text} = Line_86_Stmt_Text,
		{Copy of DIRECTION} = DIRECTION,
		{Copy of Description} = Description,
		{Copy of Desc1} = Desc1,
		{Copy of Notes} = Notes,
		{Copy of CaseCreationDate} = CaseCreationDate,
		{Copy of OpsControlDesc} = OpsControlDesc,
		{Copy of GSMOSSTATUS} = GSMOSSTATUS,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG} = toString(UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG),
		{Copy of Aging_Bucket} = Aging_Bucket,
		{Copy of Desc2} = Desc2,
		{Copy of rate} = rate,
		{Copy of UN_ACTIONED} = toString(UN_ACTIONED),
		{Copy of Item_ID} = Item_ID,
		{Copy of Deal_Number} = Deal_Number,
		{Copy of Beneficiary} = Beneficiary,
		{Copy of Bank_Ref} = Bank_Ref,
		{Copy of Dept} = Dept,
		{Copy of RTMBInd} = RTMBInd,
		{Copy of INVESTIGATOR} = INVESTIGATOR,
		{Copy of Unique_ID_MP} = Unique_ID_MP,
		{Copy of FIELD20_2} = FIELD20_2,
		{Copy of Deal_Source} = Deal_Source,
		{Copy of Aging} = toInteger(Aging),
		{Copy of UNASSIGNED_FLAG} = toString(UNASSIGNED_FLAG),
		{Copy of DF1073} = DF1073,
		{Copy of Customer_Name} = Customer_Name,
		{Copy of Source} = Source,
		{Copy of PgDesignation} = toString(PgDesignation),
		{Copy of OSI} = OSI) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Customer_Name as string,
		Case_Status as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		D_C as string,
		Line_86_Stmt_Text as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		Aging_Bucket_order as string,
		UN_ACTIONED as string,
		Aging as integer,
		Bank_Ref as string,
		Case_ID as string,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		MT as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Deal_Number as string,
		UNASSIGNED_FLAG as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		Source_Reference as string,
		Case_type as string,
		midasDealNumber as string,
		PgDesignation as string,
		Description as string,
		UN_ACTIONED_DAY2_FLAG as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Dept as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		Value_date as string,
		ReportDate as string,
		FIELD20_2 as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Incoming_TRN as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Source as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Side as string,
		Nostro as string,
		rate as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Notes as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		OSI as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		DIRECTION as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		CaseCreationDate as string,
		CCY as string,
		RTMBInd as string,
		Item_ID as string,
		Beneficiary as string,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Customer_Name,
		Case_Status = {Copy of Case Status},
		CCY_Amount = {CCY Amount},
		D_C = {D C},
		Line_86_Stmt_Text,
		Covering_Employee_Name = {Covering Employee Name},
		Aging_Bucket_order = {Copy of Aging_Bucket_order},
		UN_ACTIONED = {Copy of UN_ACTIONED},
		Aging = {Copy of Aging},
		Bank_Ref,
		Case_ID = {Case ID},
		Aging_Bucket,
		Case_Sub_Type = {Case Sub Type},

		Dept,
		Deal_Source,
		ThirdPartyCCYInd = {Copy of OSI},
		DF1073,
		Value_date = {Value date},
		ReportDate = {Copy of ReportDate},
		FIELD20_2 = {Copy of FIELD20_2},
		Desc2,
		Incoming_TRN = {Incoming TRN},
		Desc1,
		Source,
		User_Update_Date_Time = {User Update Date Time},
		Side,
		Nostro = {Copy of Nostro},
		rate,
		Tran_Ref = {Tran Ref},
		Notes,
		GSMOSSTATUS = {Copy of GSMOSSTATUS},
		OSI,
		USD_Equiv_Amt = {USD Equiv Amt},
		DIRECTION = {Copy of DIRECTION},
		Unique_ID_MP,
		CaseCreationDate,
		CCY,
		RTMBInd = {Copy of RTMBInd},
		Item_ID,
		Beneficiary,
		UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG = {Copy of UNASSIGNED_DAY2_FLAG}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
